summary.text: James Roberson is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 39 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is an education administrator and a former mayor of Knightdale.

paragraphs.text: James Roberson served as mayor of Knightdale until 2021.
On January 9, 2021, Wake County Democrats nominated him to replace Representative Darren Jackson, and Governor Roy Cooper appointed him on January 11, effective January 13, 2021.

In the 2023-2024 session, Roberson was assigned to the Appropriations, Appropriations on Agriculture and Natural and Economic Resources, Education - Community Colleges, Insurance, Local Government, and Pensions and Retirement committees, among others.
The Democratic primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
